headline: Nifty ended the week up 2% as *breadth turned weak*
subline: Only IT and pharma lifted the index. Smallcap 250 lost 1.97% on Friday.
hero_text: Nifty rose 2.0% on the week and 0.51% on Friday, but 2,058 stocks fell against 618 up. Smallcaps lost 1.97%.

why.title: Infosys carried IT higher
why.desc: Nifty IT rose 2.32%, the best sector on Friday.

why.title: Pharma extended a strong week
why.desc: Nifty Pharma rose 1.55% and has gained 7.09% over five days.

why.title: US tech sold off hard
why.desc: Nasdaq fell 2.37% and the S&P 500 lost 1.47%.

why.title: FIIs bought, DIIs trimmed
why.desc: FIIs added Rs 3,598.54 Cr in cash while DIIs sold Rs 817.51 Cr.

sector_reasons.Pharma: Led the week as pharma names kept a steady bid
sector_reasons.Healthcare: Hospitals joined pharma, with Apollo up 3.02%
sector_reasons.Media: Third best week, though it slipped on Friday
sector_reasons.Oil & Gas: Slipped over the week while peers rose
sector_reasons.Bank: Lagged as private banks sat flat on Friday
sector_reasons.Energy: Eased on Friday and trailed the week's leaders

bonus_text: IT and pharma led Friday. Consumer durables, media and energy fell, and smallcaps and midcaps closed lower.
movers_note_gainers: Trent and IndiGo led. Infosys and Apollo Hospitals added over 3% each.
movers_note_losers: Shriram Finance fell most. Nestle, M&M and Jio Financial trailed.
watch_text: On Monday, watch the 23,000 max pain and the 23,500 call wall. The US selloff is the open question.
lessons: The index rose while most stocks fell. Heavyweights carried what breadth did not.
Only the top 50 gained. Next 50, midcaps and smallcaps all closed in the red.
Two groups did the lifting. IT and pharma rose while most other sectors slipped.
Foreign cash bought into a falling tape while domestic funds sold.
alert_text: Monday opens first, with the US selloff in view. The Nifty weekly expiry falls on Tuesday 3 November.
cta_headline: A week that ended *lopsided and narrow*.
cta_sub: Wrap returns after Monday's close. Next bell is 2 November.
next_text: Next bell is Monday. Nifty expiry lands Tuesday.
caption_a:
Nifty closed the week up 2.0%, yet 2,058 stocks fell against 618 up on Friday.
Nifty IT rose 2.32%. Nifty Pharma added 1.55% and is up 7.09% on the week.
Smallcap 250 fell 1.97% even as FIIs bought Rs 3,598.54 Cr in cash.
Watch: the 23,000 max pain and 23,500 call wall on Monday.
